do.text: In a form, use a [Date picker](/components/date-picker): it shows the picked day and opens the calendar only when needed.

dont.text: Don't put a whole month in a form for one date: it takes the space and hides what was picked.

title: Rule out what cannot be picked

do.text: Pass `disabled` matchers (`{ before: today }`) so days that cannot be booked cannot be clicked.

dont.text: Don't let people click a past day and only then tell them it has passed.
